item.title: [New] Purview Insider Risk Management adds alert classification (True positive, Benign, False positive), separate from alert status, from December 2026
item.description:
Classification becomes its own field, so IRM triage reports, tuning reviews and any process that reads alert status for outcomes need to read the classification instead.

Purview · Brief insider-risk analysts on the new classification step before December and update triage runbooks and reports that infer outcome from alert status. Confirm in your own tenant.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1568697 Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-Introducing IRM Alert classification
item.description:
Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will introduce alert classification as True positive, Benign, or False positive to improve risk reporting and tuning. Rolling out from December 2026 to January 2027, it separates classification from alert status and updates alert actions. No configuration changes required; notify analysts accordingly.

item.title: [New] Intune at Ignite: software compliance policy marks devices running unsanctioned AI agents noncompliant for Conditional Access (preview); container policies for agents; vulnerability remediation agent (limited preview)
item.description:
Unapproved AI agents on endpoints become something compliance can block, and the remediation agent can patch devices automatically, so change records and alert baselines must expect agent-initiated patching.

Intune · Inventory AI agents on Windows endpoints with Defender, decide which MSI product codes to mark noncompliant, and pilot the software compliance policy in report-only Conditional Access first.
